narrative: PL3__M708AD38 is a fast-moving, smooth-demand material with a mean daily consumption of ~3,850 units and a low coefficient of variation (0.14), indicating highly predictable demand. Lead times average under one working day but exhibit moderate variability (CV 0.44), creating non-trivial replenishment uncertainty. The current SAP policy carries zero safety stock and orders at the MOQ of 830 units — an approach that creates severe stockout exposure and excessive ordering frequency. The recommended (r,Q) policy with a safety stock of 4,922 units and an order quantity of 3,839 units (capped by the 8,762-unit storage constraint) achieves the 95% service level while reducing total annual inventory cost by 67%.
warnings: Storage constraint active: unconstrained EOQ (13,639) exceeds available storage after safety stock reservation. Order quantity capped at 3,839 units.
SAP safety stock is 0 — current policy provides no buffer against demand or lead-time variability, exposing operations to stockout risk.
Two anomalous low-demand observations detected (Aug 2025); winsorisation applied at 99th percentile.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is fast-moving and follows a Normal distribution with low CV (0.14), making the classic (r,Q) EOQ-based model the most appropriate choice. Continuous review is justified by the sub-day lead times and high daily throughput, where even short stockouts have significant operational impact. The EOQ balances ordering and holding costs optimally under the Normal demand assumption.
research_insights.boundary_risk: The storage cap of 8,762 units is the binding constraint: it forces the order quantity down from the unconstrained EOQ of 13,639 to 3,839 units, increasing annual ordering frequency from ~70 to ~190 orders and raising ordering costs. If storage can be expanded, order quantity should be revisited to approach the true EOQ. The safety stock of 4,922 units already occupies 56% of the storage limit, leaving only 3,840 units of free space for cycle stock.
research_insights.escalation_flag: No MOQ-capacity infeasibility (MOQ 830 + safety stock 4,922 = 5,752 < 8,762 max storage). No escalation required.
